# Sentinel UI attribution

Upstream https://github.com/asifahamed-ece/sentinel commit cf7d2697cbdee47ece12b7e990ce2ba2d9cbd5bc.
Copyright2026 Team Core Dumped, Apache License2.0; complete LICENSE preserved here.

web/sentinel.css is the upstream docs/style.css with original notices. SafeWear web/index.html adapts the header/card layout and retains attribution; web/style.css supplies a new local Vietnamese light layout. SafeWear web/app.js is a new adapter to this project's serial/localAPI schema. No ESP-NOW or simulated-vitals firmware from Sentinel is imported.

Changes2026-10-18: translated UI, single-device initial scope, separated simulation banner and controls, no fabricated placeholders, per-vital freshness, local persisted operator events, same-origin WebSocket. No runtime third-party CDN/fonts.
